reason: Writer-side fail-fast in bh.RecordTask: a write that would leave a task status=done with no commit (none supplied on the call and none already on the row, or clearing the commit on an already-done task) is now refused before any mutation instead of being persisted and warned about later. Reuses the record command's existing exit-2 usage-error path -- no new exit code NUMBER, no schema/state field, no argv/stdin/stdout change. This is the one previously-accepted invalid write that now exits nonzero; recorded here so M0.P6.T1's post-M0 differential reconciles it as a declared delta rather than a regression. help.txt is unchanged (record's usage line does not enumerate per-condition exit cases), so no declaredDriftLinePrefixes entry is added.

deltas.detail: New exit-2 case on `record`: a transition whose resolved end-state is status=done with an empty commit is refused with "record: task %q: status=done requires field \"commit\" -- none supplied and none already recorded" (naming the task id and the missing field). Previously this write was accepted (exit 0) and persisted the stale-execution state. Covers BOTH writer paths: --status done with no --commit and none on the row, AND a --commit '' (empty) call with no --status on a task already done. Exit code 2 already existed on `record` (missing positional; unreadable/invalid execution.json; taskId not found; out-of-set --status/--test/--review) -- this adds a member to that category, no new code number.

unchanged: record's positionals, flags, mutual_exclusions, stdin (none) and stdout (bh.ExecState JSON) are byte-for-byte identical to the pre-M0 baseline -- no argv/stdin/stdout shape change.
Exit codes 0 and 1 on `record`, and every exit-2 case that existed before this task, are unchanged.
A done write that supplies a commit, or re-records done on a task already carrying one, is accepted exactly as before; non-done statuses persist with no commit exactly as before.
usage() help text (testdata/pre-m0-baseline/help.txt) is unchanged -- this is a runtime refusal, not a documented per-condition help line.
